# uptimekuma_tags (Data Source)

Lists every tag defined on the Uptime Kuma instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimekuma_tags" "all" {}

output "tag_names" {
  value = [for tag in data.uptimekuma_tags.all.tags : tag.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Color of the tag.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the tag.
- `name` (String) Name of the tag.
